```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)
unlist(first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]])
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |> filter(str_detect(incident, regex("August", ignore_case = TRUE)))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |> slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(rings) {
      mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], 1))
    }),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(rings) {
      mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], 2))
    })
  )

```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |> slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      fire_year, "<br>",
      scales::comma(gis_acres), " acres"
    )
  )

top_fires_sf <- sf::st_sf(
  top_fires,
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(
    map(
      top_fires$geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) sf::st_polygon(map(rings, \(ring) do.call(rbind, map(ring, unlist))))
    ),
    crs = 4326
  )
)
fire_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(top_fires_sf)

leaflet(top_fires_sf) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(popup = ~popup_text) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = fire_bounds[["xmin"]],
    lat1 = fire_bounds[["ymin"]],
    lng2 = fire_bounds[["xmax"]],
    lat2 = fire_bounds[["ymax"]]
  )
```
